phase_title: Runtime Service Registry & Plugin Discovery Architecture
summary: Architecture/design phase only -- no registry implementation, plugin loading, discovery execution, or execution capability introduced; no file under src/pcae/ touched. Designs how the Runtime discovers, resolves, validates, and reasons about plugins without directly coupling to concrete implementations. Freezes the core principle -- Runtime orchestrates, Registry resolves, Plugins implement -- and extends the roadmap ordering with Discoverable always, a standing property across every plugin lifecycle state. Defines the Runtime Service Registry as the canonical resolution layer between Runtime and plugins, generalizing two existing narrow precedents (PolicyRegistry, 108B; INTEGRATION_REGISTRY, 109C). Freezes an 8-facet Service Discovery model, a 15-field Plugin Manifest concept (future, no implementation), a 5-step Capability Resolution flow, Registry Responsibilities (owns registration metadata, discovery, compatibility checks, capability lookup, plugin health/lifecycle visibility, dependency metadata, current availability; does not own orchestration, policy/approval decisions, execution, audit persistence, rollback execution), and Plugin Responsibility Boundaries. Distinguishes Infrastructure plugins (Identity, Storage, Notification, Audit, Context) from Capability plugins (Intent Source, Policy, Decision, Approval, Execution Adapter). Documents the Static runtime model (designed by this phase) vs. the Dynamic runtime model (explicitly deferred to a future phase). Added docs/PCAE_RUNTIME_SERVICE_REGISTRY.md, docs/PHASE_110_RUNTIME_SERVICE_REGISTRY_ARCHITECTURE.md. docs/ROADMAP.md evaluated and found to already state the relevant long-term vision (110B) completely -- no change made. 128 new tests, a pure documentation-verification suite. Focused tests (416), governance/autonomy group (2052), and the collectible portion of release/lifecycle regression (1429/1429) all passed under -n auto; fast_green 4390/4390 (matches documented baseline). Documented validation finding (repeat occurrence, not a regression): test_phase85_integration.py and test_phase87_integration.py (68 tests) again did not complete within a practical time budget -- the same environmental performance issue first documented in 110B, now confirmed a second time via live process inspection (two independent checks five minutes apart, each showing a different xdist worker actively executing a real pcae project-state --json subprocess); not a deadlock, outside this phase's task-contract scope to repair. Unlike 110B, this phase's validation command did not reference a nonexistent test file.
